fields.description: Fairway Villas 3 is a golf-side neighbourhood at Emaar South with four-bedroom semi-detached and five-bedroom standalone villas. Both designs extend over three levels and include roof terraces. The smaller home adds a flexible room at roof level; the larger places its fifth bedroom there.
amenities: Community swimming pools for adults and children

overview: Contemporary façades are offered in two colour treatments, with earth-toned interiors and large windows. The homes are arranged beside the golf landscape with outdoor terraces. The brochure also describes a wider community park with play, a multipurpose court, retail kiosks and an events area. These shared features should be distinguished from facilities included within an individual plot.
research.locationNote: The neighbourhood is in Emaar South, part of Dubai South, with access towards Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The launch sheet places it along the golf course and linear park. Confirm the selected plot’s outlook and access, as well as actual journey times; membership or unrestricted golf-course entry is not included by implication.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 4.39m. The March 2024 launch sheet lists starts of AED 4.39m for four-bedroom villas and AED 6.44m for five-bedroom villas. These are historical category starting prices, not current inventory or a unit-specific quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule contains ten 10% payments, with the last due at estimated completion. Current resale obligations and any later developer terms need a separate unit-level check.
research.handoverNote: The Emaar-branded launch plan estimates January 2028 completion; Property Finder reports March 2028. Q1 2028 is shown as reported, with the precise contractual date awaiting confirmation.

facts.label: Published development scale
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 72 villas. It does not establish how many remain available.

facts.label: Four-bedroom layout
facts.value: A ground-floor guest room and maid’s room sit below three bedrooms. The second floor has a flex room, bathroom and terrace. The published total includes a 468.55 sq ft garage and 456.93 sq ft balcony allocation.

facts.label: Five-bedroom layout
facts.value: One bedroom is on the ground floor, three on the first and one on the second. The drawing marks lift provision, not an installed lift, alongside a maid’s room and two-car garage.

facts.label: Bedroom count cross-check
facts.value: One brochure passage refers to three and four bedrooms, but the official page, detailed layouts and other brochure sections consistently show four and five. The supported four/five-bedroom mix is used here.
